name: avrea-cli
description: Teaches the agent to use the Avrea CLI (avr) with GitHub Actions on Avrea runners and with Avrea CI: watch and diagnose runs, read logs, tests and runner metrics, inspect caches, right-size runners and create on-demand VMs.

interface.shortDescription: Watch and fix CI on Avrea
interface.longDescription: Teaches the agent to use the Avrea CLI (avr) with GitHub Actions on Avrea runners and with Avrea CI: watch and diagnose runs, read logs, tests and runner metrics, inspect caches, right-size runners and create on-demand VMs.
interface.defaultPrompt: Find the CI run for my latest commit and explain any failure.
